basis: Local integration regression of the pinned collector after patches 0001–0004; not an upstream wholesale update.
fixes: Reject expired, future, invalid, explicitly offline/unavailable and non-sensing MQTT source messages instead of creating false absence.
Include per-node age in internal MQTT observation time; repeated delivery cannot refresh source age. REST/WebSocket JSON and original source state are not rewritten.
Keep a persistent one-second maintenance interval before other biased-select branches so traffic cannot cancel or starve heartbeat and discovery timers.
A lagged broadcast receiver skips overwritten frames and continues with retained fresh input instead of permanently exiting.
All MQTT request enqueues are nonblocking because the publisher also owns the event loop that drains its bounded request queue.

Per-node pending availability/discovery failures retry on maintenance; successful enqueues are not broker acknowledgements. Fresh input immediately attempts a changed online state; stale transitions retry on the one-second maintenance timer.
limits: No runtime deployment or achieved timing/rate claim.

Source freshness threshold remains 10 seconds. One-second maintenance attempts availability transitions and pending discovery/availability work; the 30-second heartbeat remains a refresh. Scheduling, connection and broker delivery have no wall-time guarantee.
Clock-forward or backwards/future timestamps fail closed; old retained readings remain historical until availability changes.

Queue rejection is logged; rejected state is not delivered or replayed. Later fresh state can publish normally. Shutdown offline/disconnect enqueues remain best effort, without a flush/delivery guarantee.
